reviews.title: Excellent dog steps that are sturdy, easy for my dog and me to use. Folds.
reviews.body:
I've had the devil's own time trying to get my dog to use a ramp or steps inside the house, and he just won't do it. I think he's still mad at me because I wouldn't get up and leave in the middle of the night when I was evidently taking up too much of our bed. But to get in the car with these stairs to go for a car ride? Oh, sure, he's up for that.
My dog weighs 90 pounds, and he had no trouble going up or down these stairs. I'm not sure if the promise of a car ride was enough to lure him or what, but he did very well on these. The stairs have excellent traction - I tested them a little myself, and my dog had no trouble.
We have a four-door sedan, and he still had trouble getting into the car, but not any more. He's good to go. And I do mean GO. Any time.
These stairs are well made, sturdy, and have great traction. My 90-pound Lab had no trouble with these. Weight limit is 200 pounds. They fold for easy storage and weigh just under 12 pounds.
What I like most about these, besides the fact that my dog can and will use them happily, is that there's a metal fixing buckle so the stairs won't wobble. I know my dog appreciates that and so do I. Safety first always, then the fun starts.
I would highly recommend these dog stairs for cars, SUVs, trucks, etc. I don't have a clue how these would do with a semi truck. These are great for everyday use, and I may end up ordering these in a smaller size (fewer steps) to see if he'll use them for the bed or couch.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 30 de agosto de 2023

reviews.title: Great ramp! Dog is a fan
reviews.body:
I got this for my dog who likes to travel. She’s a pitbull. She’s a little short so this makes it a lot easier for her to get into the car. She was a little apprehensive at first, but now she uses it like it’s natural.
I like the foam on the end that leans on my tailgate. It definitely prevents scratching. The carabiner latch also helps keep it in place. I just latch it onto the hitch for my trunk. My only complaint is that it’s a little overpriced. I’d wait until it’s on sale.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 6 de noviembre de 2023

reviews.title: Helps my senior dog
reviews.body: This dog ramp works really well for my senior dog. I have a full size suv and the five step fits perfectly on the back hatch. The first time I used it I didn't hook it onto the car and it did move when he used it. When it is clipped it, it doesn't move at all. My old dog was able to figure it out on the first try and I wished I had gotten something like this sooner. It folds up nicely and is not too heavy to move.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 22 de agosto de 2023
